recipes.title: Adversarial review
recipes.description: Challenge an implementation with concrete failure-mode hypotheses.

arguments.name: minimum_failure_modes
arguments.description: Minimum number of plausible failure-mode hypotheses to investigate.

recipes.title: Review breaking changes
recipes.description: Review compatibility and coordinated migration boundaries.

recipes.title: Continue until done
recipes.description: Continue authorized independent slices until observable completion or a real blocker.

arguments.name: done_condition
arguments.description: Observable condition that must be satisfied before the task may stop successfully.
examples: the approved Done When criteria are satisfied

recipes.title: Harden tests with mutation testing
recipes.description: Increase meaningful coverage and require mutation-testing evidence.

arguments.name: minimum_percentage_points
arguments.description: Minimum percentage-point increase in coverage required by the prompt.

recipes.title: Simplify deletion first
recipes.description: Prefer safe deletion and deduplication before extension or abstraction.

recipes.title: Re-ground with discovery
recipes.description: Re-ground an unclear or stale task against current repository evidence before editing.

recipes.title: Execute plan with blind-spot check
recipes.description: Challenge material plan assumptions, amend only disproved steps, then continue execution.

recipes.title: Dispatch one execution slice
recipes.description: Create a bounded current execution prompt from an existing durable task and authority.

recipes.title: Produce evidence report
recipes.description: Require completion claims to be bounded by observable verification evidence.

recipes.title: Audit missing pieces
recipes.description: Find evidence-backed gaps in tests, validation, recovery, observability or boundaries.

recipes.title: Implement, audit, simplify
recipes.description: Run implementation, correctness and simplification as separate evidence-backed passes.

recipes.title: Strengthen an existing plan
recipes.description: Treat an existing plan as the minimum floor and strengthen only evidence-backed gaps.

recipes.title: Plan a wider horizon
recipes.description: Produce a bounded milestone plan for a stated horizon instead of only the next step.

recipes.title: Prepare production-ready handoff
recipes.description: Create one bounded self-contained execution handoff for a fresh coding agent.

recipes.title: Hunt regressions
recipes.description: Investigate a bounded number of high-risk regression hypotheses with concrete evidence.

arguments.name: minimum_findings
arguments.description: Minimum number of concrete regression hypotheses or search targets to investigate.

recipes.title: Reproduce before fixing
recipes.description: Require a failing automated reproduction before changing production code for a bug.

recipes.title: Reject and restart
recipes.description: Discard an implementation that violated the approved contract while preserving valid evidence.

recipes.title: Bound retries
recipes.description: Stop speculative retries when repeated failures produce no new discriminating evidence.

arguments.name: maximum_failures
arguments.description: Maximum repeated attributable failures allowed without new discriminating evidence.

recipes.title: Use test-driven development
recipes.description: Apply a RED-GREEN-REFACTOR loop to each behavior-changing slice.

recipes.title: Prepare durable work package
recipes.description: Create durable resumable task-card content without turning it into execution authority.
